deadline.value: Fall deadline January 15; most students are admitted for Fall.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers go to students with financial limitations, and only after a faculty advisor agrees to review the application and pay the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: We offer application fee waivers to students who have financial limitation.

also.quote: Once you have communicated with a faculty advisor, they have agreed to review your application, and have confirmed that they will pay the fee, you may email the graduate advisor to request the waiver code

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are no longer required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are no longer required.

supervisor.value: Applicants must name 3 potential advisors and are more likely to be accepted if they have contacted faculty first.
supervisor.quote: Students who have identified and contacted their top faculty choices are more likely to be accepted into a graduate program.

also.quote: Prior to submitting an application, identify 3 potential advising faculty in our department.

funding.value: Accepted students are fully funded (tuition and mandatory fees covered) through research or teaching assistantships or fellowships; international fees may not be covered.
funding.quote: Once accepted into our program, our students are fully funded; meaning their general graduate tuition and mandatory fees are covered.

entry_route.value: A direct-to-PhD route exists with no prerequisites, but most students without a master's start in the master's program and change classification after about a year and a half.
entry_route.quote: There are no prerequisites to apply to our graduate programs.

also.quote: Most student who don't have their master's yet and want to do Direct to PhD, don't end up taking this route.

notes: Covers Geology and Geophysics PhDs; a Geological Engineering PhD is also listed. Fee and English rules are the university's.
